entities.summary: Alessandro "Alex" Staropoli is a keyboard player, composer, leader and co-founder of the Italian symphonic power metal band Rhapsody of Fire. He does the orchestral arrangements in all the band's songs. Following the split with Luca Turilli, Staropoli is Rhapsody of Fire's only remaining founding member.
